home.heroDesc: Three specialized AI agents read job profiles and CVs, check requirements, and uncover information gaps — the final decision is yours.
home.problemDesc: Without a dedicated HR department, every hiring process is a burden: varying CV formats, missing details, and no traceable evaluation.
home.solutionDesc: From job profile to clarifying questions: every agent has exactly one task — transparent, verifiable, traceable.
home.step1Desc: Upload job profile & CVs — as PDF or text.
home.step2Desc: CV Agent structures data, Matching Agent checks every requirement.
home.step4Desc: Three agents, one clean, traceable flow.
home.step5Desc: Every processing step is thoroughly documented.
home.resultsDesc: Clean candidate profiles, a transparent qualification checklist, and a comprehensive Audit Log — Human-in-the-Loop by Design. No ranking, no recommendations.
home.ctaDesc: Start in seconds — no setup required.
home.resultsImgAlt: Structured candidate data and qualification checklist
